description: The bar chart illustrates the effect of different multilingual BERT models (mBERT-L2, XLM-L2, mBERT-R2, XLM-R2, mBERT-B2, XLM-B2) on various Indo-European language families (IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Ind, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, Uralic) in terms of a specific metric. The vertical axis represents the effect, which is a numerical value, and the horizontal axis lists the Indo-European language families. Each bar represents the effect of a model on a language family, with the height of the bar indicating the magnitude of the effect. The bars are color-coded to distinguish between the different models. The chart includes error bars, indicating the variability or confidence interval of the effect. The values on the vertical axis range from 0 to 30, with increments of 10, and the units are not specified. The chart does not provide any information on the sorting of the bars or any visual emphasis on specific bars.
